Watt 's meticulous mind and tireless dedication led to the creation of the Watt engine , a revolutionary device that would @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ , the Watt engine featured a separate condenser , which allowed it to efficiently harness steam power , minimizing energy waste and vastly improving its performance . <p> The introduction of the Watt engine could n't have come at a more opportune time . These engines found applications in various industries , from textile mills to mines , and their adoption rapidly spread . The Watt engine 's efficiency was a game-changer , enabling factories to produce goods more quickly and cost-effectively . It became the beating heart of the industrial landscape , propelling economies forward at an unprecedented pace . <p> As the Industrial Revolution unfolded , Watt engines became the cornerstone of technological progress . They powered locomotives , ships , and a multitude of machinery , allowing society to move goods and people faster and farther than ever before . The impact of these engines was felt far and wide , from the heart of the Industrial Revolution to the fabric of modern society . Created by the Department of Town and Country Planning ( PLANMalaysia ) in collaboration with the Malaysian Green Technology and Climate Change Corporation ( MGTC ) , the new platform is designed to become a major point of reference for the development of Malaysia 's EV charging infrastructure . <p> Previously known as the National EV Charging Station Dashboard ( NEVCSD ) , it is one of several modules that are part of an even larger big data project by PLANMalaysia called the Malaysia Urban Observatory ( MUO ) . In general , the online dashboard allows the public to monitor the progress of the EV charging infrastructure throughout Malaysia . <h> The type of data available through MEVnet <p> Being a national-level big data project , there are so many data points contained within MEVnet . Hence , it is so easy to get overwhelmed by them at first but let us walk you through some of the dashboard 's main @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ look at the overall statistics of the national EV charging infrastructure through this cloud-based dashboard . As of today , MEVnet stated that there are currently 1,430 EV charging bays in 620 locations throughout Malaysia . <p> The data is then further divided into the type of chargers and whether they are located indoors or outdoors . Meanwhile , do note that the percentage shown on the left side of the dashboard is based on the government 's target of 10,000 charging points and not the proposed figure shown on the right side of the dashboard . <p> PLANMalaysia has shortlisted the famed Pasar Siti Khadijah in Kota Bharu as one of the proposed EV charging sites in Kelantan . <p> The MEVnet dashboard also lets you dive deeper into state and local government data by setting the parameters on the top right section of the dashboard . This not only allows you to check out existing EV charging sites but also locations that PLANMalaysia has earmarked as suitable locations to deploy EV chargers . <p> You can learn more about a location by clicking on the charger icon on @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ EV charging site or a proposed site . A table would then pop up and displays several information regarding the location including its type , the amount of AC and DC chargers , and whether the chargers are located indoors or outdoors . <h> The accuracy of MEVnet 's data <p> MEVnet 's listing for Sunway Pyramid , as of 3 November 2023 . <p> As for the accuracy of the data , it is hard for us to verify each of the spots since there are already close to 1,500 EV charging sites but we did find some discrepancies . For example , Sunway Pyramid currently has nine JomCharge/Gentari AC chargers while there are also another five AC chargers operated by ParkEasy/Shell Recharge . <p> Before MEVnet was officially launched , it was displayed to the public as the NEVCSD at PLANMalaysia 's booth during Smart Nation Expo 2023 . <p> Based on our conversation with PLANMalaysia 's staff when MUO was showcased at the Smart Nation Expo back in September , we learned that the data for NEVCSD was mainly supplied by MGTC and Malaysia Automotive , Robotics @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ MARii 's logo was not on MEVnet though which is rather intriguing . <p> According to MEVnet 's FAQ document , the database will be updated every month . That being said , it is still subject to data availability . <h> Do n't use MEVnet to locate EV chargers <p> Despite having an elaborate map , MEVnet is not something that you should use to locate EV chargers since it is not designed for that purpose . This historical overview offers a profound insight into the foundations upon which modern surveying technology now stands . <p> Surveying , in its most rudimentary form , can be traced back to the dawn of civilization itself . The ancient Egyptians , for instance , are credited with some of the earliest recorded land surveying activities , primarily focused on demarcating property boundaries along the fertile Nile banks . To achieve this , they employed a blend of geometry and astronomy , making use of simple tools such as ropes with knots to @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ ingenious methodologies represented the rudimentary but invaluable beginnings of surveying , casting the first threads in the intricate tapestry of land measurement . <p> Fast-forward to more recent centuries , and we encounter the compass and the theodolite , tools that were groundbreaking in their time . The compass , initially developed by the Chinese during the Han Dynasty around the 2nd century BC , became a cornerstone of early surveying , allowing for the determination of cardinal directions with remarkable precision . The theodolite , a more sophisticated instrument , arrived on the scene in the 16th century and heralded a leap forward in angular measurements . Surveyors could now measure horizontal and vertical angles with an unprecedented level of accuracy . <p> Yet , even as surveying techniques advanced , they were inherently limited by the tools of their era . Traditional surveying methods were labor-intensive , painstakingly slow , and subject to errors that could accumulate over long distances . These limitations were exacerbated when it came to surveying challenging terrains , such as rugged mountains or dense forests . As our world grew more complex , with the expansion of cities , infrastructure , and transportation networks , the demand for surveying became more pressing . Traditional surveying methods could no longer keep pace with the rapid changes and development of the modern world . Surveyors faced mounting pressure to deliver precise measurements more efficiently and within shorter timeframes . <p> Thus , the need for technological advancements in surveying was born . The limitations of traditional surveying methods laid the foundation for a revolution in the industry . This revolution would see the integration of cutting-edge tools and technologies , from GPS and LiDAR to remote sensing and 3D scanning . GPS and GNSS <p> When it comes to surveying , the importance of GPS and GNSS can not be overstated . GPS , initially developed by the United States Department of Defense , has become @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ system relies on a constellation of satellites orbiting the Earth , which transmit signals to GPS receivers on the ground . Surveyors use these signals to precisely determine their location , allowing for the measurement of distances and angles with remarkable accuracy . <p> In land surveying , GPS technology enables professionals to establish control points , measure distances between them , and create accurate maps . Aerial surveying , too , has been revolutionized by GPS . Aircraft and drones equipped with GPS receivers can capture georeferenced imagery , transforming the way we collect data from the skies . The result is not only improved precision but also significant time savings compared to traditional ground surveys . <p> Recent developments in GPS technology have further enhanced its utility in surveying . With the advent of real-time kinematic ( RTK ) and post-processing techniques , surveyors can achieve centimeter-level accuracy . The integration of multiple constellations of satellites , such as the U.S. GPS , Russian GLONASS , and European Galileo , has bolstered the reliability and availability of GNSS services . Let 's get started on an exciting new adventure . <h> Early Pioneers and Their Contributions <p> Image by -- historyforkids <p> Early pioneers in the field of jet engine development , such as Sir Frank Whittle and Hans von Ohain , stand as true visionaries whose contributions laid the very foundation for the remarkable technology that propels modern aviation . Their groundbreaking work , though separated by geographic boundaries , converged in shaping the course of jet engine history . <p> Sir Frank Whittle , a British engineer , is often regarded as the father of the jet engine . In the early 1930s , he conceptualized the turbojet engine , a notion that would fundamentally transform the way aircraft would fly . Whittle 's vision was realized through the creation of the world 's first turbojet engine , the Power Jets W.1 , in 1937 . His innovation , which employed a centrifugal compressor , combustion chamber , and axial-flow turbine , marked a dramatic departure from conventional piston engines . This revolutionary design allowed for @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ the cyclic operation of pistons . It was a paradigm shift that propelled aircraft into new realms of speed and efficiency . The Power Jets W.1 laid the foundation for the jet engine as we know it today . <p> On the other side of the Atlantic , Hans von Ohain , a German engineer , was independently working on a similar concept . In 1935 , he submitted a patent for a jet engine design that would later become the basis for the first operational jet engine , the Heinkel He s 3 . Unlike Whittle 's engine , von Ohain 's design incorporated an axial-flow compressor , which significantly enhanced efficiency and performance . The Heinkel He s 3 , developed during the late 1930s , became the world 's first jet engine to power an aircraft , the Heinkel He 178 , in 1939 . Von Ohain 's contribution to jet engine development , although separate from Whittle 's , mirrored the rapid advancements happening in the field . <p> These early pioneers not only conceptualized jet engines but also overcame significant technical challenges . Their innovative @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ in a new era of aviation . The jet engine 's ability to provide consistent thrust , high speeds , and efficient power marked a significant departure from the limitations of piston engines . It was clear that a technological revolution was underway , one that would forever alter the course of aviation history . <p> The work of Sir Frank Whittle and Hans von Ohain serves as a testament to the power of human ingenuity , vision , and the pursuit of the seemingly impossible . In the ever-advancing field of aviation technology , their legacy remains a source of inspiration for engineers , innovators , and aviation enthusiasts alike . <h> Turbojet Engines : The Breakthrough <p> In the world of aviation , the development of turbojet engines represented nothing short of a groundbreaking revolution @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ air compression and combustion , ultimately propelling aircraft into the jet age . In this comprehensive exploration , we will uncover the fundamental principles that underpin turbojet engines , delving into the vital components that make them work with unmatched efficiency and precision . <h> The Core Principle : Turbojet Propulsion <p> At the heart of turbojet engines lies a deceptively simple principle : air compression and combustion . To put it plainly , turbojet engines operate on the idea that air can be accelerated to high velocities by utilizing the force of expanding gases . The engine draws in vast quantities of air , compresses it , mixes it with fuel , ignites the mixture , and then expels the resulting high-speed exhaust gases at the rear of the engine . This powerful expulsion of gases in one direction generates an equal and opposite force in the opposite direction , known as thrust . It is this thrust that propels the aircraft forward , allowing it to overcome the forces of drag and gravity . <h> The Axial-Flow Compressor : Enhancing Efficiency <p> The axial-flow compressor is a pivotal @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ efficiency . This ingenious device consists of a series of rotating and stationary blades , arranged in a cylindrical fashion . As air enters the compressor , it is rapidly accelerated and compressed . This compression serves two essential purposes . Firstly , it ensures a denser intake of air into the combustion chamber , which , in turn , leads to a more potent combustion process . Secondly , the compressor reduces the air 's velocity , as prescribed by Bernoulli 's principle , which enhances the overall efficiency of the engine . <p> The significance of the axial-flow compressor can not be overstated . This technological advancement marked a quantum leap in aviation , enabling aircraft to attain higher speeds and altitudes than ever before . <h> The Combustion Chamber and Turbine : Crucial Synergy <p> Within the turbojet engine , the combustion chamber and turbine represent a dynamic duo , playing complementary roles in the combustion @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ the magic happens , as fuel is injected and mixed with the compressed air . Malaysia used to export tonnes of them to Japan in the 1980s . <p> The Mexican papaya can grow as big as 10 pounds ( 4.5kg ) . The Tainung papaya originates from Taiwan . <p> For now , the major producers of this fruit are Hawaii ( USA ) , Brazil and India . <p> Characteristics <p> Papaya tree occurs in three sexual forms : male , female and hermaphrodite . The male produces only pollen , and never any fruit . It is a key substance used in meat tenderisers . <p> Cultivation <p> Papaya can be propagated either from seeds or through grafting .
